notes: XCUT-05 consolidates the former TypeScript catalog into this JSON seed and canonicalizes permission keys from dominio:acao to dominio.acao.
The live pre-XCUT-05 JSON already had 19 entries; the 6 entries absent there and recovered from the TypeScript catalog are: auth.read, iam.read, gestao.read, gestao.write, rh.read, rh.write.
